evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected installed native triplet, complete current parameter setter/factory/constructor bodies, all selected class registration records and parameter-factory-installed SetParamsBlock slots, current fixed input read partitions and anonymous update dispatch/constants/handler byte shapes.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Current registered parameter setters retain the reviewed serialized read offsets and widths. Typed fixed-prefix reads match the SDK serialized read sequence even where compiler copy instructions and register allocation differ; those changed bodies are labelled reviewed current reads, not exact SDK-code matches. Structural rows retain anonymous raw reads. Current convolution updates retain their signed selector/table/handler and bulk destination joins.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous parameter partitions, stored values and numeric update selectors do not establish public control names, mathematical helper identity or live DSP selection.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Selected class registration, readable serialized buffers, applicable optional/vector branches and native length/version constraints are required. Variable Matrix Reverb tails remain conditional. Current named schema/reader transfer does not establish current evaluated audio or rerun historical host/PCM cohorts.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live parameter/effect association, runtime RTPC/state/revision selection, mathematical/output parity, full effect lifecycle and audibility.
